blockedSpaceKeys.title: Blocked spaces
blockedSpaceKeys.description: Confluence space keys that must never be exported (case-insensitive), e.g. HR or LEGAL. Pages from these spaces are left out of every export.

disableLiveRender.title: Disable live render
disableLiveRender.description: When true, the diagram fidelity mode (printing pages from the real Confluence UI) is turned off and cannot be enabled by users.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per export
maxPages.description: Exports with more pages than this are rejected.

defaultOptions.title: Enforced default export options
defaultOptions.description: Default PDF options that override the user's saved defaults. Users can still change options for an individual export.

includePageMeta.title: Include page header (breadcrumb, last updated, link)
